number: 第二百四十八条の四の三十七
heading_en: System for Reporting the CVA Risk Equivalent Amount
summary_ja: SA―CVA採用最終指定親会社は、CVAリスク相当額を金融庁長官に月ごとに報告する体制を整備する。
summary_en: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA establishes a system for reporting the CVA risk equivalent amount to the Commissioner monthly.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the SA-CVA shall establish a system for reporting the CVA risk equivalent amount to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency every month.
